messages:
emma: Heads up — console shows a weird quantile mismatch for /v2/embeddings in eu-west-1. UI p95 is 120ms but p50 is 200ms. Screenshot pasted.

sofia: wait what. p95 < p50? that's impossible unless we're comparing different sample sets. did you toggle any origin filters?

emma: No filters. Just timeframe = last 1h, endpoint = /v2/embeddings, agg = by endpoint. I clicked refresh after the rollout.

liam: could be the dashboard using two different sources: the sparkline is from raw samples, percentiles from rollup. Are we sure the p95 is coming from the same aggregation window?

raj: Quick check: I ran a raw query against telemetry store:
```
SELECT approx_quantile(latency_ms, 0.5) as p50, approx_quantile(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95
FROM requests
WHERE endpoint='/v2/embeddings' AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```
Got p50=185, p95=420. so backend looks sane.

emma: OK so UI is lying. Any recent console deploy that touched the latency widget?

infra-bot: deploy: console-frontend@v1.34.2 to production by ci/cd-bot at 2026-03-20T11:02:00Z :rocket:

sofia: v1.34.2 included the new quantile micro-aggregation change — it streams a pre-computed summary from the aggregator to cut cost. I wonder if the UI accidentally shows pctl from the summary but p50 from the raw endpoint. bad join.

liam: Another angle: routing policy change yesterday sent a subset of traffic to embeddings-v2-small model on dedicated capacity. Those requests are much faster (30ms) and also get cached. If p95 is computed on the pre-aggregated summary that excluded cached responses while p50 includes them, you could see inversion.

raj: Good point. I can see two sample tags: `served_variant=small` and `cache_status=hit|miss`. If the aggregator uses a filter `cache_status != null` by mistake, p95 would be computed over misses only.

emma: Can someone grep the aggregator logs for the summary payload for that endpoint/time? I want to see the sample_count and which tags were included.

sofia: grabbing now.

sofia: quick paste from aggregator out: `{ endpoint: "/v2/embeddings", region: "eu-west-1", sample_count: 1820, tiers: {cache_hit: 1400, cache_miss: 420}, quantiles: {q50: 0.030, q95: 0.120} }`

liam: aha — aggregator's quantiles are in seconds (0.03s = 30ms), that's the small model/cache hit bucket. But UI label says "p95 (ms)" and then mixes that 120ms with p50 from raw (185ms) — two sources, two unit conventions.

emma: so bug = UI mixes pre-aggregated quantiles (in seconds, derived from subset) with raw p50 (in ms, full sample). We need a fix: make UI fetch quantiles from the same canonical source and normalize units.

raj: I'll open a tracking issue and add the repro query + aggregator payload. Also flag the aggregator to include `units: "ms"` in payload.

sofia: I'll patch the frontend to stop mixing sources; add a visual badge when data comes from "summary" vs "raw".

liam: Also propose a quick console hotfix: if sample_count < 2000 show a warning and link to raw query so people don't misinterpret.

emma: Thanks all. Action items: Raj -> telem issue + sample payload; Sofia -> frontend guard + badge; Liam -> dashboard UX warning PR. I'll DM product to add to hotfix board. :+1:

raj: opened issue #PLAT-4821 with logs and repro steps.

sofia: created PR 789 for the badge and source-consistency check.

liam: created PR 790 for the low-sample warning.

emma: closing the loop — will follow up if anything else pops up.
